WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        i."CNES",
        CASE
            WHEN c."DS_CAPITULO" = 'XV. Gravidez, parto e puerpério' THEN 1
            WHEN c."DS_GRUPO" = 'O94-O99 Outras afecções obstétricas NCOP' THEN 1
            WHEN c."DS_CATEGORIA" IN (
                'Tetano obstetrico',
                'Outr traum obstetricos',
                'Embolia orig obstetrica',
                'Morte obstetrica de causa NE',
                'Morte p/sequelas causas obstetricas diretas'
            ) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS obstetrica_flag,
        CASE WHEN i."MORTE" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS obito_flag
    FROM internacoes i
    LEFT JOIN cid c
        ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID"
), agg AS (
    SELECT
        "CNES",
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE obstetrica_flag = 1) AS internacoes_obstetricas,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE obstetrica_flag = 1 AND obito_flag = 1) AS obitos_obstetricos,
        100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE obstetrica_flag = 1 AND obito_flag = 1)
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE obstetrica_flag = 1), 0) AS taxa_mortalidade_obstetrica
    FROM base
    GROUP BY "CNES"
    HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE obstetrica_flag = 1) > 500
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        "CNES",
        internacoes_obstetricas,
        obitos_obstetricos,
        ROUND(taxa_mortalidade_obstetrica, 2) AS taxa_mortalidade_obstetrica,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY 1
            ORDER BY taxa_mortalidade_obstetrica DESC, "CNES" ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM agg
)
SELECT

    internacoes_obstetricas,
    obitos_obstetricos,
    taxa_mortalidade_obstetrica
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 10
ORDER BY taxa_mortalidade_obstetrica DESC, "CNES" ASC;
